title: lotus stipularis
intro: Lotus stipularis, commonly known as the Lotus stipe or Lotus stip, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotus stipularis include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
